_about: Single declared source for env-declared network egress. loki doctor --airgap derives its optional-egress rows from declared; tests/test-airgap-egress-registry.sh fails when a LOKI_*_URL, LOKI_*_HOST or LOKI_*_ENDPOINT reader appears in autonomy, loki-ts/src or dashboard that is in neither list.

declared.name: mirofish_market_validation
declared.disable: unset LOKI_MIROFISH_URL, or pass --no-mirofish to loki start
declared.note: MiroFish market validation: health check and requests go to this URL when set

declared.name: webhook_notifications
declared.note: Generic webhook: notification payloads are POSTed to this URL

declared.name: slack_notifications
declared.disable: unset LOKI_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL (or the variable named by LOKI_SLACK_WEBHOOK_ENV)
declared.note: Slack events from the engine are POSTed to this URL

declared.name: jira_writeback
declared.disable: unset LOKI_JIRA_URL (and JIRA_BASE_URL) or the Jira token
declared.note: Issue comments and transitions are written back to this Jira host when the token and email are also set

declared.name: linear_writeback
declared.disable: unset LOKI_LINEAR_TOKEN (and LINEAR_API_KEY); LOKI_LINEAR_URL only redirects the call
declared.note: Linear writeback calls this URL, default the public Linear API, whenever a Linear token is set

declared.name: custom_model_route
declared.disable: unset LOKI_MODEL_BASE_URL and do not use a custom/ model route
declared.note: Inference for a custom/<id> model route goes to this base URL; point it inside your network or at a local runtime

declared.name: remote_cluster_submit
declared.disable: unset LOKI_REMOTE_URL and do not pass --remote to loki start
declared.note: loki start --remote submits the run to this deployed cluster

declared.name: control_plane_client
declared.disable: unset LOKI_CONTROL_URL (default is a loopback control plane)
declared.note: loki control and run shipping talk to this control plane; loopback unless overridden

declared.name: queue_consumer
declared.disable: unset LOKI_QUEUE_URL and REDIS_URL, or use the file backend
declared.note: The queue consumer connects to this Redis server; loopback unless overridden

declared.name: audit_syslog_forwarding
declared.disable: unset LOKI_AUDIT_SYSLOG_HOST (forwarding is off by default)
declared.note: Dashboard audit log lines are forwarded to this syslog host

declared.name: otel_export
declared.disable: unset LOKI_OTEL_ENDPOINT (export is off by default)
declared.note: OpenTelemetry spans are exported to this collector

declared.name: hosted_proof_publish
declared.disable: unset LOKI_HOSTED_ENDPOINT and do not pass --hosted to loki proof share
declared.note: loki proof share --hosted POSTs the redacted proof page to this endpoint

declared.name: metadata_store
declared.note: External metadata store connection used by the lokistore factory when a remote backend is selected

declared.name: telemetry
declared.disable: loki telemetry off, DO_NOT_TRACK=1, or LOKI_AIRGAP=true
declared.note: Reported by the dedicated telemetry row

declared.name: telemetry
declared.disable: loki telemetry off, DO_NOT_TRACK=1, or LOKI_AIRGAP=true
declared.note: Reported by the dedicated telemetry row
